title: Techspressionism Video Archive
description: A searchable, citable transcript archive of Techspressionism's recorded video: the Techspressionist Salons (running since September 2020), artist interviews, roundtable discussions and artist presentations. Transcripts are machine-generated (Zoom transcripts, Whisper speech recognition, YouTube captions) and corrected by rule and by hand; they may contain errors, and every quote should be verified against the recording. Every passage is timestamped on the YouTube video's own timeline, and citations use the YouTube address of the recording at that second. data/recordings.csv lists every recording with its YouTube address, so this permanent record says where each video lives. Generated by the pipeline in this repository.
